info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API allows users to access real-time information regarding the status of logistics shipments. This endpoint serves logistics managers and operators who need to monitor the progress of their shipments effectively. Users can retrieve data on various shipment statuses, enhancing visibility and enabling informed decision-making. By integrating this API into their systems, companies can proactively manage their supply chains and ensure timely deliveries.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the status of shipments in the system. It provides valuable insights into delivery progress, current location, and estimated arrival times, helping businesses monitor their logistics effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of shipments. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify which shipment's status is being queried.

200.description: The request was successful, and shipment status data is returned.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body for the operation to get the status of shipments.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the shipment operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the shipment.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the shipment.

audit.description: Details of the audit trail for the operation.

ListLogisticsShipmentsStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the shipment status operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the shipment record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the shipment record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated system.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing the audit details for the shipment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, in milliseconds.
